quote.text: And even though it is ordained to be, what does it avail to run out to meet your suffering? You will suffer soon enough, when it arrives; so look forward meanwhile to better things.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Realize that pain and challenges are inevitable when raising children; instead of reacting to every hardship, use these moments as opportunities to grow alongside your child.
    • Focus on nurturing hope and positive expectations—by preparing for better days, you create an environment where every difficulty becomes a building block for resilience and growth.
  • Leadership:
    • Accept that adversity is part of the leadership journey; rather than rushing to eliminate suffering immediately, acknowledge that trials will come and prepare for them with wisdom.
    • Look ahead with vision—by focusing on future successes and improvements, you inspire your team to move forward even in tough times, fostering a culture of perseverance.
  • Product Management:
    • Understand that challenges in product development are natural; waiting for problems to resolve on their own is less effective than anticipating and planning for improvements.
    • Shift your perspective from immediate setbacks to long-term gains, using each difficulty as a stepping stone towards better, more innovative solutions.
